Key.Japanese: 紙巻たばこ パリジェンヌ
箱入り紙巻たばこ (パリジェンヌ)

Key.English:
The Swiss classic since 1887, from Boncourt.
Contains 20 cigarettes.
Warning: Smoking can cause your AI squad to ignore your orders.
